title: peucedanum junceum
intro: Peucedanum junceum, commonly known as Chinese celery or wild celery, is a type of plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Peucedanum junceum include expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential natural remedy for respiratory and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
